Vertigo Trio +Debbie Lane
Tim Blackman (piano), Doug Toland (drums), Ethan Focht (bass)
Debbie Lane is a vocalist who sings around the Boston area in a wide variety of styles.  Vertigo is currently backing her up with jazz standards, Great American Songbook, and Bossa Nova.
This Arlington-based group originally formed based on their love of the Bill Evans Trio. Vertigo Trio focuses on group improvisation over songs of the Great American Songbook and other jazz standards. Additionally, Vertigo is fascinated by the relationship of film and music, and frequently plays music that originated in the golden era of Hollywood from 1929 to 1959.

1772128937.4021227.description:
Sunburn is a classic ’80s rock reunion and reminiscence! Formed in an Ohio high school in the 1980s, we cut our teeth playing school dances, nightclubs, and even a wedding before graduation sent us our separate ways across different states. Decades later, we reconnected and began reuniting each summer for a high-energy reunion gig, with shows in our new homes of Ohio, Tennessee, and Pennsylvania, and now we’re excited to bring our first show to my home for the past 25 years of Newton, Massachusetts.
We deliver crowd-pleasing ’80s rock favorites from bands like Guns N' Roses, Aerosmith, and Kiss.  Big riffs, big smiles, and pure nostalgia that gets the whole porch singing along.

1772166640.4040511.description: A multigenerational act featuring 17 year old vocalist Maya Saturn and band performing her originals and a diverse mix of rock, soul and jazz covers.

1772168231.4039127.description: A jazz trio featuring saxophone, bass and drums playing a number of standards.

She has been profiled in The Boston Globe (https://www.bostonglobe.com/2022/04/06/metro/its-how-i-make-sense-world-newton-attorney-creates-book-her-song-writing/) as well as many local publications - see https://figcitynews.com/2023/09/world-as-refuge-celebrating-resilience-diversity/& https://figcitynews.com/2024/06/poetry-party-at-newtonville-books-aug-4/. She hopes that folks find beauty and joy in her work and believes that music should be a regular part of everyday life.

We’re a garage punk band out of Middlesex, started in spring 2025 in our singer Nicole’s basement. After a summer of lineup changes, we found the right bass player and drummer who locked into our sound. Influenced by The Breeders, Heavens to Betsy, and The Distillers, we blend the punch of early Green Day with a Kim Deal-inspired edge.
Our first show is March 11 at The Jungle at 11pm.

Newton appearances have included: National Night Out, Winterfest, Newton Cultural Alliance, Marathon Day, Porchfest, PTO, and approximately 20 years of Prince Street Halloween.

People tell me that I seem to communicate directly with them, and that's what I try to do, something I learned as a stage actor. I try to connect with people through my music, my lyrics. I like to have fun, make people laugh, but also connect with people on an emotional level.

1774100244.501096.description:
Led by Alex Calabrese, Boston-based indie-folk band Old Tom & The Lookouts blend the introspective grit of Americana with the emotional rawness of indie rock. Known for their brooding lyrics and powerful storytelling, the band explores themes of mental health, love, and resilience. Drawing influences from artists like Tom Waits, Frightened Rabbit, and Phoebe Bridgers, Calabrese’s evocative vocals and poignant songwriting strike a chord with listeners searching for authenticity and emotional depth.

Old Tom & the Lookouts recently sold out Club Passim on March 19th, 2026!

1774125169.506402.description: Rob Cunningham is a Maine-based singer-songwriter whose music lives at the crossroads of folk, roots rock, and Americana, guided by his father’s wisdom, a deep sense of social justice, and a lifelong fascination with the complexities of love. With acoustic guitar and harmonica at the center of his sound, Cunningham writes songs that feel like honest conversations—thoughtful, unpretentious, and quietly powerful.

1775086361.828809.description: Dægeob is a funk-groove inspired indie soul life raft of hope. We write simple songs that amplify our faith in humans being and in being human. Your day job may give you stress, but our Dægeob is about celebrating the joy of others and leaning in to navigate life.

1775182091.847626.description: I’m a singing guitarist/keyboardist offering a warm, indie-leaning take on classic and modern songs for intimate events – art galleries, bookstores, small gatherings, and laid-back parties. My set blends familiar favorites (Bill Withers, Elton John, Harry Styles, David Bowie, and more) with tasteful deep cuts, arranged for voice, guitar or piano, and subtle rhythm support. I keep the volume conversation-friendly and the vibe relaxed, focusing on good time feel, clear vocals, and songs that make people smile, hum along, or just enjoy having a musician in the room.

1775184159.847676.description: Boston-area singer-songwriter Lars Wicklund brings heartfelt acoustic songs shaped by influences like John Lennon and Tom Petty. His music blends themes of positivity, perseverance, and connection, reflection.

1775314212.870684.description: We are a musical group based in Needham Massachusetts that has been together for over 20 years.  We started out as a Jazz/Funk band but our sound has become more eclectic which reflects our love of all musical genres with the underlying goal of a solid groove. Our music has Jazz, Blues, Latin, Funk and Reggae influences. Our first self-titled CD was released in 2021. We regularly gig around the suburbs of Boston.

1775358570.881250.description: Nicole Dobberpuhl leads her Boston-based pop/rock band (performing under the same name), playing originals and covers. 1775577363.942549.description: Covers across the decades -- come sing along with the whole family!!

While the band loves to play all genres of music, they focus on a mix of high energy cover and original songs with psychedelic and jam flavors.

'The Newtalians' reimagine your favorite Italian songs (and more) with modern, fresh arrangements ranging from ska to jazz, from rock to funk. Be ready to dance and sing along. Newton-based, spaghetti-raised.


The Newtalians have played scores of shows in the greater Boston area, ranging from outdoor festivals, to bars, to large auditoriums. Their repertoire of cover and original Italian songs keeps the crowd engaged with call and response, easy choruses and clapping. This is a high energy, family friendly show.

1776292007.1149583.description: Elijah Stone is a New York-based singer-songwriter blending pop, rock, soul, and blues into a fresh yet timeless sound. Big Moon

about
Marilyn Kirby image
Marilyn Kirby
Woodstock, New York


Marilyn is returning to play at her childhood home.(1949 to 2017, Newton North HighSchool class of 1967)
Ms. Kirby’s instrument of choice is a beat up old Telecaster Her songwriting is strong and honest, telling stories that will move you to cry, dance, and everything in between, as she rocks to out to each song with her belting, beautiful voice.
Currently residing in Woodstock, NY, . She also does music therapy with patients with mental illness and dementia

1776782905.1291488.description: Lucky Jane is the artist name of Lucy Geller, a vocalist originally from Oregon and based in Boston, MA. There’s a little something for everyone, and a lot for those who value well-crafted lyrics and musical exploration.

1776867864.1316375.description: The Patch Notes are a jazz combo from Boston, MA, built on a reverence for classic and modern video game themes. Their sets bring an improv tradition to some of the most recognizable (and just occasionally obscure) soundtracks that have graced living room televisions. Think Charlie Parker, Koji Kondo, Duke Ellington, Yasunori Mitsuda and K.K. Slider--The Patch Notes can bring them all.

1776876829.1318487.description: We are a punk/rock band from Quincy Massachusetts. Our music is heavy, upbeat, and melodic. We are three friends who write songs about abstract feelings, identity expression, and leftism. Our music is for people who love rocking out and dancing.

Come for the originals, stay for the funk!

1777493431.1472223.description: Pacific Marimba plays fun, energetic music from Zimbabwe on homemade wooden marimbas. Anywhere from 3 to 6 players have performed with the band for smiling and dancing crowds all over New England. Join us as we light up the street with driving rhythms and our big, joyful sound. Catch the beat, clap along, and try not to dance (we dare you).

1777674833.1517002.other_genre: Jug band - aka acoustic blues & swing
1777674833.1517002.description:
Outrageous Fortune is a Boston-based acoustic vintage jazz and blues trio. Their repertoire features innovative arrangements of early jazz (Duke Ellington and Louis Armstrong); blues and jug band music (Robert Johnson and the Memphis Jug Band); and traditional folk music.

The group features Chris Welles on guitar; Rod Thomas on harmonica; and Dan Dick on jug, bass, washboard, dobro, banjo, and mandolin. Audiences are wowed by their instrumental virtuosity and are delighted by their smooth three-part vocal harmonies, their strong groove, and the abundant joy that infuses every performance

1777744016.1531160.description: Friends in Low Places is Jeff Summit (guitar and banjo) Bruce Gore (mandolin) David Rothberg (guitar) Kenny Raskin (ukulele) and Art Schatz (violin). Everyone sings. We play Americana - folk, blues, bluegrass, country, swing and American song book.

1778260755.1669018.description: 6 singers performing popular and gospel songs, both a cappella and with piano
